# PIXO Brain

> Admin Hub for PIXO Learn — backend control panel for managing students, curriculum, payments, employees, and AI behavior. Authenticated staff only.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Redirects to the admin sign-in page.
- [Admin Login](/admin/login): Sign in for PIXO Learn staff and founders.

## Optional

The remainder of the application (`/admin/*`) is gated behind authentication and intentionally excluded from indexing.
